description.zh: 模糊搜索关键词。仅支持实体的name字段，且大小写不敏感
description.en: The keyword for a case-insensitive fuzzy search on the `name` field of the entity.

description.zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
description.en: Selectors used to filter environments by their `labels`. Only environments that match all selectors are returned. The selectors are combined by using AND logic.

description.zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始
description.en: The page number to retrieve, starting from 1. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

description.zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Defaults to 100. Valid values: 1 to 100.
